wholePhysicalScope: Named municipal-data OpenStreetMap footprint and surveyed building parts, original ground crop, three exact cleared Qualla photographs and the castle’s own architectural accounts.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the five wings, two courtyard openings, three principal towers and Renaissance attic.
limitations: The native map fixes the compound plan and varied courtyard levels. The documented Bell Tower height controls the highest point. Other roof and tower heights, lower arcades on less visible sides and fine relief use reference proportions.
